onlyMenu.q: I only want the QR code menu. Is that possible?
onlyMenu.a: Yes. The QR Menu plan is paid once, with no subscription: your menu online and printed, laminated QR codes for your tables. To change a price or add a dish, send us a WhatsApp message and we take care of it.

app.q: Do my customers need an app?
app.a: No. They scan the QR code with the camera and the menu opens in the browser, without an account.

start.q: How long does it take to start?
start.a: Under 30 minutes: a photo of the menu, your colours, then printing the QR codes.

print.a: You print them from your space, on paper or at a print shop. We can also point you to acrylic or wooden tents.

internet.q: What if the Wi-Fi is slow?
internet.a: The menu is light and loads fast even on 3G. Customers can also use their mobile data.

change.a: Yes, anytime from your phone: one dish, a category or a percentage increase for many.

staff.q: How do my waiters get the calls?
staff.a: On the counter tablet or their phone, with a sound, a vibration and a notification.

data.a: With European hosts (European Union), backed up every day. Your menu stays yours.

howItWorks.title: From the table to the kitchen, in six steps
howItWorks.intro: Taply is a QR code on the table and a web menu without downloads. Here is the exact path for customers and staff.

scan.title: 1. The customer scans the QR
scan.body: Every table has its own unique QR printed on a small card sitting on top. The customer opens their phone camera, points, and the menu opens. Nothing to install, no account to create.

browse.title: 2. They browse the menu in 3 languages
browse.body: French, Arabic (right-to-left) and English. Photos, prices, allergens and descriptions. Sold-out items are marked automatically. Loads in under 2 seconds on 3G.

call.title: 3. They call the waiter or ask for the bill
call.body: Two buttons at the bottom of the screen. The customer picks one and the alert flies to the staff's phone or tablet immediately, with the table number and the time.

serve.title: 4. The waiter gets the alert in real time
serve.body: Sound, vibration and notification. One tap acknowledges it and frees the table for the next call. Average pickup time drops below two minutes.

rate.title: 5. The customer rates the experience
rate.body: After the bill: a 1-to-5 star rating and an optional comment. For 4 or 5 stars, the customer is invited to leave a Google review — reputation grows on its own.

edit.title: 6. The owner updates the menu any time
edit.body: Changed a price, added a dish, launched a happy hour: the owner edits from their phone and the customer menu changes in seconds. On the Menu QR plan, a WhatsApp message is enough — we do it for you.
